detail.longDescription: 💁🏻‍♀️ TIL: 🐭🏃‍♂️ For 30 years, UC # Riverside researchers bred # mice that run about three times as far as control mice. They expected a trade-off, fewer offspring or shorter lives, as a standard cost in evolutionary # biology , but after following 100 # breeding pairs their whole lives, the runners produced nearly as many pups and lived just as long. 👉 https://www. zmescience.com/science/biology /researchers-bred-supermice-for-extreme-running-they-expected-a-downside-but-there-wasnt-any/ # running # evolution # science # genetics # longevity # exercise # research # zoology # california
